name: vrooli-bridge.qualification
purpose: Admit one bounded Bridge qualification request, refuse unauthorized or malformed target scope before owner admission, and return a durable Test Genie receipt that can be resumed by id.

request_key.description: Stable qualification request identity. Reusing it with the same inputs attaches to the same owner operation; changed inputs are a conflict.

candidate_digest.description: Immutable sha256:<64 lowercase hex> candidate identity.

target_ids.description: Explicit target identities in this qualification request.

authorized_target_ids.description: Target identities covered by the caller's explicit authority.

authorization_ref.description: Opaque owner-grant reference. The program records the reference, never a credential value.

phases.description: Bounded Test Genie phases required for this qualification attempt. The current owner uses contracts for the retired integration CLI/API lane.

evidence_cells.description: Existing cell observations. Each row has cell_id and a status of passed, failed, stale, unavailable, or pending.

plan_only.description: Return the admitted intent without creating the owner operation. Used for safe contract inspection.

assumptions: Test Genie owns validation admission, execution, evidence, idempotency, and one server-owned wait.
Target authorization is supplied by an owner-controlled grant reference; this program does not mint or infer authority.
Native target effects and release promotion remain later Bridge qualification obligations.
invariants: Validate request and target authority before calling any binding.
Never mutate a target; the only admitted effect is creating a Test Genie validation operation.
Never convert pending, stale, unavailable, or failed cells into passed cells.
Return at most eight evidence-cell rows and one owner receipt.
Return one bounded envelope on every path.
A receipt is not a passing result until its owner terminal evidence is read.

signals.request: Normalized request identity, candidate digest, target count, and bounded phase selection.
signals.authority: Whether every requested target is covered by the explicit authority input.
signals.cells: Capped evidence-cell observations with their original status.
signals.intent: Exact owner validation intent when admission is planned.
signals.receipt: Owner receipt identity and terminal state when Test Genie admits the request.
signals.wait_command: One server-owned wait command for a non-terminal receipt.
signals.resume_command: One owner get command for the retained receipt.

outputs.evidence: Opaque authorization reference, candidate digest, receipt id, and cell references; never secret values.
